title: Post 1: $BTC $79.6K Shorting Setup & ETF Outflows
raw: Bitcoin is currently at $79,659, down from last month's high of $87,000. Next resistance is at $84,000, current level is the support, while next floor support is $76,000. For the ETFs, last week's inflow was 300 million while outflow was over 1 billion in the past two weeks, and Bitcoin hasn't really moved this week. Fear and greed index is standing at 50. My prediction is since the current level is at $79,659, Bitcoin is looking to further dump and go to the next support floor at $76,000. This is a setup for shorting with targets around 78,000 to 76,000 to 74,000.
